QuestInfo.name: Helping Nella with Her Problem
QuestInfo.0: Time to gently interrogate the people of Kerning City, as Ryden instructed. Talk to #bNella#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Nella frequents the #bPharmacy#k all the time. Clear out the Stirges in the Pharmacy basement to help her out.



#o9300524# #r#a26141##k
QuestInfo.2: Nella told you that the Dark Lord is good at looking after the kids in Kerning City, which is why she and the other younglings in Kerning City trust him. That's all the info you could wheedle out of her.

0.0: That Dark Lord sent you? Perfect timing! EMERGENCY! We need help in the Pharmacy!

yes.0: The Pharmacy is a mess! The old fart, I mean, old dude at the Pharmacy is too busy filling orders to do any cleaning, but I just know the mess is driving him crazy. YOU HAVE TO HELP HIM!
yes.1: There are a bunch of #rStirges#k in the basement. Wipe them off the face of Maple World!

no.0: Didn't the Dark Lord send you to help us?!

1.0: Did you clear out the basement? Awesome! Now Grandpa won't scold me for slacking on my chores. Thanks!

yes.0: Huh? You want to know what the Dark Lord is like? He's SUPER nice. All the other kids and I love him and not just because he always sends people to help us with our chores, honest!
yes.1: #b(That's all Nella has to say. Next is JM From tha Streetz.)

mob.0: You still haven't gone to the #bPharmacy#k? I'm telling you the place is infested with monsters. MONSTERS!
